steps.eval: const pause = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const v = await test(); if (v) return v; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const box = () => document.querySelector('#send_textarea'); const open = async () => { if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-open-workspace').click(); const modal = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]'), 10000, 'the workspace'); if (modal.dataset.context !== 'story') { const tab = [...modal.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'This chat'); if (!tab) throw new Error('no Story context button'); tab.click(); await until(() => modal.dataset.context === 'story', 5000, 'the Story context'); } const play = await until(() => modal.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-play'), 5000, 'the Play page'); play.click(); const opener = await until(() => document.querySelector('#so-open-suggestions'), 10000, 'the suggestions button on Play'); if (opener.closest('details')) throw new Error('suggestions are still a disclosure inside the workspace'); opener.click(); await until(() => !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]'), 5000, 'the workspace to close'); return until(() => document.querySelector('#so-sheet-ideas'), 5000, 'the suggestions panel over the chat'); }; const ready = () => until(() => { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-so=suggestion]')]; return b.length >= 2 ? b : null; }, 15000, 'suggestions'); globalThis.__g61b = { pause, until, box, open, ready }; return true;
